title: Short stay levy of 7.5% (Victoria)
summary: From 1 January 2025 a 7.5% levy applies to the total booking fee for short stays under 28 days in residential premises, with hotels, motels, caravan parks and principal places of residence exempt.

commenced.what: Short stay levy applies to bookings accepted from this date

direction_rationale: A levy borne by short-stay hosts but not by exempt hotels and motels raises rivals' costs and tilts competition toward incumbent commercial accommodation.
comparison: Other states without a levy (NSW, QLD, SA); WA register from same date
confounders: local council caps (e.g. Byron Shire 60 days)

verified.notes: Assent reported as 29 Oct 2024 only in secondary sources; left null.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 14-15 October 2026 from the sources cited. Not yet checked by a person: verify dates, industries and the direction hypothesis before use.

assessment.summary: A 7.5% levy on short stays booked in residential premises, from which hotels, motels and caravan parks are exempt. It tilts competition towards incumbent commercial accommodation; its aim, more homes for long-term rental, is not weighed here.

marks.reason: A levy on one type of accommodation but not its rivals distorts guests' choices.
